title.id: Sistem Informasi Rekam Medis & Antrean Klinik
title.en: Clinical Medical Records & Outpatient Queue System

description.id: Aplikasi tata kelola antrean pasien dan riwayat medis poliklinik berbasis web. Dibangun untuk menyederhanakan input periksa dokter serta monitoring stok resep obat harian.
description.en: A web-based queue and outpatient medical records platform. Designed to streamline doctor consultations and daily pharmacy prescription tracking.

description.id: Platform pencatatan mutasi barang multi-cabang, rekapitulasi surat jalan masuk-keluar, dan peringatan stok minimum barang secara berkala.
description.en: Multi-branch stock transfer platform with inbound-outbound consignment logging and automated minimum inventory alerts.

description.id: Aplikasi mobile pendataan kehadiran teknisi operasional dengan validasi radius GPS kantor dan pencatatan riwayat penugasan lapangan.
description.en: Mobile application for operational field technician attendance with office GPS geofencing validation and assignment tracking.

description.id: Situs portofolio pribadi yang dirancang cepat, mandiri tanpa dependensi berat, dan memenuhi standar aksesibilitas WCAG AA.
description.en: Personal portfolio website engineered for high speed, zero heavy dependencies, and full WCAG AA accessibility compliance.
